# Set Player Allowed Heroes

Source: [wiki article 4426](../archive/4426.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Set Player Allowed Heroes](../../api/actions/set-player-allowed-heroes.md).

<a id="wiki-4426-n1"></a>

- Changing allowed heroes forces a player whose current hero is unavailable to select another and respawn.

<a id="wiki-4426-n2"></a>

- Supplying no heroes has no effect, so an empty hero list does not directly disable selection.
